About Convertible Credit
What is the PCX 50% Deposit Bonus?
It is a welcome bonus for new PCX clients. When you make your first deposit, we add 50% of it to your account as trading credit, up to a maximum of $5,000. The credit increases your buying power so you can open larger positions. Unlike most bonuses in the market, this credit can gradually turn into real withdrawable funds as you trade.
How much credit will I receive?
50% of your first deposit. For example, a $500 deposit gives you $250 in credit, a $1,000 deposit gives you $500, and a $10,000 deposit gives you the maximum of $5,000.
Who can join this promotion?
The bonus is available to new clients who register during the campaign period, complete identity verification, and make a qualifying first deposit.
Is there a minimum deposit?
Yes. Your first deposit must be at least $100 in a single transaction. Please note that if your first deposit is below $100, the bonus entitlement is forfeited and later deposits will not qualify, so make your first deposit count.
Does the bonus apply to every deposit?
No. The bonus applies to your first deposit only. This is a one time offer per client, so we recommend planning the size of your first deposit carefully.
Which account types are eligible?
Standard, ECN, and Precious Metal accounts. Cent accounts and PAMM accounts are not eligible. Each client can register one bonus account.
How do I join?
Four simple steps: register your PCX account, verify your identity, make your first deposit of $100 or more, then activate your credit from the activation email we send once your deposit is confirmed. The credit is added automatically, normally within one hour.
Credit Settlement & Withdrawals
Can I withdraw the credit?
The credit itself cannot be withdrawn. However, it converts into real balance as you trade. Every month you trade at least 1 lot of valid volume, part of your credit becomes withdrawable money.
How does the conversion work?
For every 1 lot of valid volume you close during a calendar month, $1 of your credit is converted into balance. The conversion runs automatically on the first weekday of the following month, based on the volume you closed in the previous month. Your credit is reduced by the same amount that is converted, and the remaining credit carries over to the next month.
Can you give an example?
Sure. Say you deposit $1,000 and receive $500 in credit. During your first month you close 25 lots. On the first weekday of the next month, $25 is added to your balance as withdrawable funds and your remaining credit becomes $475. This continues month after month for as long as you keep trading and credit remains.
Is there a minimum volume each month?
Yes, 1 lot of valid closed volume per calendar month. If you close less than 1 lot in a month, no conversion happens that month and your credit simply carries over.
What happens to positions that are still open at the end of the month?
Nothing is lost. Volume is counted when a position is closed, so an open position will count toward the month in which you eventually close it.
Does the credit expire?
No. There is no expiry date. The credit stays on your account for as long as your account remains in good standing under the promotion rules.
Capital Protection Rules
Which trades count as valid volume?
Closed positions on your bonus account, held for at least 2 minutes, across all available instruments. Partial closes count according to the portion closed. When you close a position against an opposite position (Close By), the paired volume counts once, not twice.
Is copy trading allowed?
Yes, volume from copy trading counts as long as it follows the standard validity rules. PAMM accounts are not part of this promotion.
What is not allowed?
Strategies that exploit technical loopholes rather than real market movement, such as latency arbitrage or price error exploitation, as well as holding multiple bonus accounts under different names. These practices can lead to the bonus being cancelled. Full details are in the Terms and Conditions.
Account Terms & Eligibility
What is the 50% drawdown rule?
If your account equity, calculated without the credit, falls to 50% or less of your real balance, the credit is removed from your account automatically and permanently. For example, with a $1,000 balance, the credit is removed if your floating losses reach $500. Keep in mind that removing the credit lowers your margin, which may affect open positions. Your client portal always shows the exact level at which this would happen on your account.
What happens to my credit if I make a withdrawal?
Withdrawals reduce your credit proportionally. For example, if you withdraw 40% of your balance, your credit is reduced by 40% as well. You will always see a preview of the credit adjustment before you confirm any withdrawal. Internal transfers to another account are treated the same way as withdrawals.
What if my credit reaches zero before the monthly conversion?
Conversion only applies to credit that is still on the account when the monthly conversion runs. If the credit has already been removed or reduced to zero, the volume from that month is not converted.
Where can I track my bonus?
Your client portal shows your current credit, the valid volume you have generated this month, your estimated next conversion, and the drawdown level that applies to your account.
Where can I read the full terms?
The complete Terms and Conditions are available on this page. Anything not covered there follows the Promotional Use Policy in our Client Agreement. We encourage every participant to read both before joining.

Terms & Conditions

PCX 50% Convertible Deposit Bonus

These Terms & Conditions ("Bonus Terms") govern the PCX 50% Convertible Deposit Bonus program (the "Program"), offered by the Prime Codex Group of companies ("PCX", "the Company"). By opting in, the Client acknowledges having read, understood and accepted these Bonus Terms in full, in addition to the Client Agreement, Risk Disclosure and all other applicable legal documents of the Company.

1. Definitions

1.1. "Balance" means the Client's real funds in the trading account: deposits and realized profits/losses, less withdrawals. Balance excludes Credit.

1.2. "Credit" (or "Bonus Credit") means the non-withdrawable bonus funds granted under this Program, recorded in the credit facility of the trading account.

1.3. "Net Equity" means Balance plus the aggregate floating profit/loss of all open positions, excluding Credit.

1.4. "First Deposit" means the first deposit successfully credited to the Client's eligible trading account following registration.

1.5. "Valid Volume" means trading volume, measured in standard lots on a round-turn basis from closed positions, that satisfies all conditions of Clause 6.

1.6. "Conversion Period" means one calendar month, determined by trading server time.

1.7. "Client" means one natural person whose identity has been verified through the Company's KYC procedure. Multiple accounts held by the same person constitute one Client.

2. Eligibility & Participation

2.1. The Program is open to Clients who complete their registration with PCX during the Program enrollment period: 15 August 2026 to 15 November 2026 (the "Campaign Period"). The Company may extend, shorten, or close the Campaign Period at its discretion in accordance with Clause 9.

2.2. Participation requires the Client to opt in to the Program through the client portal and accept these Bonus Terms before making the First Deposit. Deposits made prior to opt-in cannot be claimed retroactively.

2.3. The bonus applies to the First Deposit only. Subsequent deposits do not qualify for any bonus under this Program.

2.4. The minimum qualifying First Deposit is USD 100 in a single transaction. If the First Deposit is below USD 100, the entitlement to the bonus is forfeited permanently, including for any subsequent deposits.

2.5. Eligible account types: Standard, ECN, and Precious Metal accounts. Cent accounts are not eligible. PAMM accounts (whether manager or investor) are not eligible. Accounts engaged in copy trading are eligible, subject to Clauses 6 and 8.

2.6. Each Client may hold one (1) bonus account only, designated at opt-in. The bonus is granted once per Client (per verified identity), regardless of the number of accounts or profiles held.

2.7. The Program is unavailable to residents of jurisdictions where the Company does not offer its services, as listed on the Company's website.

2.8. Completion of identity verification (KYC) is required before Credit is granted.

3. Bonus Credit

3.1. The Credit amount equals 50% of the First Deposit, subject to a maximum of USD 5,000 per Client. The amount is rounded down to the nearest cent.

3.2. Credit is granted automatically to the designated bonus account, normally within one (1) hour of the First Deposit being settled and KYC being approved.

3.3. Credit is not withdrawable under any circumstances. Credit serves solely to increase the account's margin (buying power), enabling the Client to open larger positions.

3.4. Credit is not intended to absorb trading losses. The mechanism in Clause 4 enforces this principle.

3.5. Credit has no expiry date. Credit remains on the account until it is (i) converted pursuant to Clause 5, (ii) removed pursuant to Clause 4, (iii) reduced or removed pursuant to Clause 7 (withdrawals), or (iv) cancelled pursuant to Clause 8.

4. Automatic Credit Removal (50% Drawdown Rule)

4.1. If at any time Net Equity is less than or equal to 50% of Balance (equivalently: aggregate floating losses reach 50% of the Client's real Balance), the entire Credit is removed from the account automatically and permanently.

4.2. Credit removed under this Clause is not reinstated under any circumstances, including after subsequent deposits.

4.3. Account equity is monitored continuously by automated systems. The values of Balance, Net Equity, and Credit at the moment of removal are recorded in the Company's logs, which shall be conclusive evidence of the event.

4.4. The removal of Credit reduces the account's equity and margin. If open positions no longer meet margin requirements following the removal, the standard margin call and stop-out rules of the Company apply, and positions may be liquidated. The Client bears full responsibility for monitoring account equity and acknowledges this risk by participating in the Program.

4.5. In the event that the Bonus Credit is removed, forfeited, or taken out from the Client's account with or without prior notice, the applicable terms shall be determined based on whether the account is processed with credit or without credit, as specified in the relevant Terms and Conditions. Any removal or adjustment of the Bonus Credit may affect the Client's available balance, equity, or other applicable account condition.

5. Conversion of Credit to Balance

5.1. Credit can be converted into withdrawable Balance based on the Client's Valid Volume, at a rate of USD 1 per 1.00 standard lot of Valid Volume.

5.2. Conversion is processed in a monthly batch executed on the first weekday of each calendar month, before market open (server time). If the 1st falls on a weekend, the batch runs on the following Monday.

5.3. The batch counts all Valid Volume from positions closed during the preceding calendar month. Volume attribution is determined by position close time, regardless of when the position was opened. Positions remaining open at month-end are not counted for that month; they are counted in the month in which they are closed.

5.4. Minimum monthly threshold: conversion for a given month occurs only if the Client's Valid Volume for that month is at least 1.00 lot. If the threshold is not met, no conversion occurs for that month and the Credit remains unchanged.

5.5. Once the threshold is met, the conversion amount equals the total Valid Volume (including fractional lots) multiplied by USD 1, capped at the remaining Credit at the time the batch is executed:

Conversion = min(Valid Volume × USD 1, remaining Credit)

5.6. The converted amount is added to the Balance and is withdrawable without further conditions (subject to Clause 7 while any Credit remains on the account). Credit is reduced by the converted amount at a 1:1 ratio.

5.7. If the remaining Credit at the time of the batch is zero, including as a result of removal under Clause 4, cancellation under Clause 8, or reduction under Clause 7, no conversion occurs, regardless of the Valid Volume generated. Such volume is forfeited for conversion purposes and does not carry over.

5.8. Valid Volume does not roll over between months; the volume counter resets at the start of each calendar month. Unconverted Credit rolls over indefinitely.

6. Valid Volume

6.1. Valid Volume is calculated exclusively from closed positions on the designated bonus account, in standard lots (round turn), across all instruments offered (forex, metals, indices, energy, futures), each counted according to its contract lot size.

6.2. The following volume is excluded from Valid Volume:

a. Positions held open for less than two (2) minutes (120 seconds), measured from position opening to closing;

b. In the case of a partial close, each closed portion is assessed separately: the portion's volume counts according to its lot size, and the duration condition in (a) is measured from the position's opening to the closing of that portion;

c. "Close By" operations (closing a position against an opposite position on the same instrument): the paired volume is counted once, not as the sum of both sides. If either position in the pair has been open for less than two (2) minutes at the time of the Close By, the paired volume is not counted at all;

d. Volume generated through latency arbitrage, tick-data exploitation, off-quote or price-error exploitation, or any Expert Advisor or strategy designed to exploit technical vulnerabilities rather than market movement (see also Clause 8).

7. Withdrawals & Internal Transfers

7.1. Any withdrawal from the bonus account while Credit remains on the account reduces the Credit proportionally:

New Credit = Current Credit × (1 − Withdrawal Amount ÷ Balance before withdrawal)

7.2. Internal transfers out of the bonus account to any other account are treated as withdrawals for the purposes of Clause 7.1.

7.3. The client portal displays a preview of the Credit deduction before the Client confirms any withdrawal or internal transfer.

7.4. Amounts previously converted to Balance under Clause 5 are the Client's funds; however, while any Credit remains on the account, withdrawing such funds is subject to Clause 7.1 like any other Balance.

8. Prohibited Practices & Cancellation

8.1. The following are considered abuse of the Program ("Prohibited Practices"):

a. Operating or benefiting from more than one bonus account, including through accounts opened under other names or coordinated with other persons;

b. Hedging or offsetting positions across accounts within PCX or with other brokers with the purpose of extracting bonus value without genuine market exposure;

c. The practices described in Clause 6.2(d);

d. Coordinated copy-trading structures in which one strategy provider drives volume across multiple bonus accounts for the purpose of farming conversions;

e. Any other scheme intended to derive value from the Program contrary to its purpose.

8.2. The Company monitors trading patterns through automated and manual review. Suspected Prohibited Practices are investigated before any sanction is applied; sanctions are not applied automatically.

8.3. Where a Prohibited Practice is established, the Company may, proportionately to the severity of the breach: (i) exclude the affected volume from Valid Volume; (ii) cancel the Credit in full; (iii) in serious or organized cases, cancel Credit together with converted amounts and any profits derived from the Prohibited Practice, and/or terminate the Client's participation in the Program and close the Client's accounts in accordance with the Client Agreement.

8.4. The Client will be notified in writing of any sanction and may appeal through the Company's support channels within fourteen (14) days of notification.

9. General Provisions

9.1. The Company may amend these Bonus Terms, or suspend or terminate the Program, at any time. Material changes will be announced on the Company's website and/or client portal with or without reasonable prior notice. Credit already granted, and conversions already executed, will be honored under the terms in force at the time of grant or execution, except in cases falling under Clause 8.

9.2. In the event of any conflict between these Bonus Terms and the Client Agreement, the Client Agreement prevails, except where these Bonus Terms expressly provide otherwise in relation to the Program.

9.3. The Company's records (including server logs and system timestamps) are conclusive evidence of all events relevant to the Program, absent manifest error.

9.4. The Program constitutes a promotional offer and does not create any entitlement beyond what is expressly stated herein. The Company's good-faith determination on any matter concerning the Program is final, subject to the appeal right in Clause 8.4.

9.5. Any matter not expressly addressed in these Bonus Terms shall be governed entirely by the Promotional Use Policy set out in the Client Agreement. In such cases, the Promotional Use Policy applies as if fully incorporated into these Bonus Terms.

9.6. These Bonus Terms are governed by the same law and subject to the same dispute-resolution provisions as the Client Agreement of the entity with which the Client contracts.

9.7. If any provision of these Bonus Terms is held invalid, the remaining provisions remain in full force.

10. Risk Warning

Trading leveraged products such as Forex and CFDs carries a high degree of risk to your capital and may not be suitable for all investors. The Credit granted under this Program increases your available margin and therefore your capacity to open larger positions, which amplifies both potential profits and potential losses on your own funds. The removal of Credit under Clause 4 may trigger margin calls or the liquidation of open positions. Please ensure that you fully understand the risks involved and, if necessary, seek independent advice. Please read the full Risk Disclosure.
